name: Center of Excellence for Operational Ocean and Great Lakes Mapping
use: NOAA operational ocean and Great Lakes mapping center, training, plus 35,000 sq ft high bay for industry partners and the Olson Center
builtText: Under construction: ground broken Nov 2025, beam signing July 13, 2026, opening fall 2027
style: Contemporary (per rendering: blue metal-clad office block and grey high-bay volume)

facts.text: A 70,500 sq ft building at Main Street and Mast Road by the West Edge lot, designed by Stantec and built by Gilbane, scheduled to open fall 2027.
Funded largely by over $25 million in NOAA and NIST awards plus UNH investment; includes 35,000 sq ft of high-bay space.
Ground was broken in November; projected cost $34 million, including $20M from NOAA and $5M from NIST; first step of "The Edge" mixed-use district.
UNH Facilities describes a 2023 $20M NOAA award for a facility of office, training and high-bay space.

noaa.title: UNH and Partners Celebrate Construction Milestone of Ocean Mapping Center of Excellence (2026-07)

nhpr.title: UNH project for major research and mixed-use community underway in Durham (2026-05)

verdict: NOAA's 70,500 sq ft ocean-mapping centre with a big high bay, rising at Main Street and Mast Road for 2027.
notes: Name corrected to the official "Center of Excellence for Operational Ocean and Great Lakes Mapping". notunh has no name for it. Size conflict: UNH Facilities page says 20,500 sq ft (likely the NOAA-funded portion or old figure); UNH News and NHPR say 70,500. NHPR says operational by November 2027. built=2027 is the planned opening. Old row said groundbreaking early 2026; NHPR says November (2025).
judgeNotes: Unranked (under construction). Exterior judged from a rendering only.
